name: Call and response
description: A reciprocal structure in which a lead voice or performer prompts and an audience, chorus, or second performer answers.

name: Rhythmic speech
description: Speech shaped through meter, cadence, repetition, pitch, and rhythmic emphasis.

name: Improvisation
description: Real-time creation or variation of vocal, musical, or performative material within an established rhythmic or social framework.

name: Signifying
description: Indirect, playful, coded, or competitive verbal expression whose meaning depends on context, delivery, and shared cultural knowledge.

name: Genealogical storytelling
description: The preservation and transmission of lineage, memory, identity, and historical knowledge through performed narrative.
